<div class="wp-block-columns container bradius8"><!-- wp:column {"verticalAlignment":"center","className":"container"} -->
<div class="wp-block-column is-vertically-aligned-center container"><!-- wp:heading {"textAlign":"center"} -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">На мастер-классе каждый получает</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:columns -->
<div class="wp-block-columns"><!-- wp:column -->
<div class="wp-block-column"><!-- wp:image {"id":489,"width":"170px","height":"170px","scale":"cover","sizeSlug":"full","linkDestination":"none","align":"center","className":"item-decor"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full is-resized item-decor"><img src="http://emoshop.aleks9sw.beget.tech/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/04.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-489" style="object-fit:cover;width:170px;height:170px"/></figure>
<!-- /wp:image -->

<!-- wp:heading {"textAlign":"center","level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Творческий подход</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"align":"center"} -->
<p class="has-text-align-center">Вдохновляю на креативность и помогаю раскрыть таланты</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></div>
<!-- /wp:column -->

<!-- wp:column -->
<div class="wp-block-column"><!-- wp:image {"id":490,"width":"170px","aspectRatio":"1","scale":"cover","sizeSlug":"full","linkDestination":"none","align":"center","className":"item-decor"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full is-resized item-decor"><img src="http://emoshop.aleks9sw.beget.tech/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/05.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-490" style="aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;width:170px"/></figure>
<!-- /wp:image -->

<!-- wp:heading {"textAlign":"center","level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Эксклюзивные подарки</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"align":"center"} -->
<p class="has-text-align-center">Изделия ручной работы — яркий и запоминающийся подарок</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></div>
<!-- /wp:column -->

<!-- wp:column -->
<div class="wp-block-column"><!-- wp:image {"id":491,"width":"170px","aspectRatio":"1","scale":"cover","sizeSlug":"full","linkDestination":"none","align":"center","className":"item-decor"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full is-resized item-decor"><img src="http://emoshop.aleks9sw.beget.tech/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/06.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-491" style="aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;width:170px"/></figure>
<!-- /wp:image -->

<!-- wp:heading {"textAlign":"center","level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Любовь к деталям</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"align":"center"} -->
<p class="has-text-align-center">Внимание каждой мелочи, чтобы мастер класс был особенным</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></div>
<!-- /wp:column --></div>
<!-- /wp:columns --></div>
<!-- /wp:column --></div>
<!-- /wp:columns -->

<!-- wp:columns {"className":"container bradius8"} -->
<div class="wp-block-columns container bradius8"><!-- wp:column {"verticalAlignment":"center","className":"container"} -->
<div class="wp-block-column is-vertically-aligned-center container"><!-- wp:heading {"textAlign":"center"} -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Преимущества наших мероприятий</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:columns -->
<div class="wp-block-columns"><!-- wp:column {"width":"15%"} -->
<div class="wp-block-column" style="flex-basis:15%"></div>
<!-- /wp:column -->

<!-- wp:column {"width":"70%"} -->
<div class="wp-block-column" style="flex-basis:70%"><!-- wp:paragraph {"align":"center","style":{"typography":{"fontStyle":"normal","fontWeight":"300","fontSize":"20px"}}} -->
<p class="has-text-align-center" style="font-size:20px;font-style:normal;font-weight:300">Почему выбирают именно наши мастер классы</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></div>
<!-- /wp:column -->

<!-- wp:column {"width":"15%"} -->
<div class="wp-block-column" style="flex-basis:15%"></div>
<!-- /wp:column --></div>
<!-- /wp:columns -->

<!-- wp:columns -->
<div class="wp-block-columns"><!-- wp:column -->
<div class="wp-block-column"><!-- wp:image {"id":495,"width":"170px","height":"170px","scale":"cover","sizeSlug":"full","linkDestination":"none","align":"center","className":"item-decor"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full is-resized item-decor"><img src="http://emoshop.aleks9sw.beget.tech/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/adv1.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-495" style="object-fit:cover;width:170px;height:170px"/></figure>
<!-- /wp:image -->

<!-- wp:heading {"textAlign":"center","level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Локация с атмосферой</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"align":"center"} -->
<p class="has-text-align-center">Стильное пространство с удобными мольбертами и уютной зоной отдыха</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></div>
<!-- /wp:column -->

<!-- wp:column -->
<div class="wp-block-column"><!-- wp:image {"id":497,"width":"170px","aspectRatio":"1","scale":"cover","sizeSlug":"full","linkDestination":"none","align":"center","className":"item-decor"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full is-resized item-decor"><img src="http://emoshop.aleks9sw.beget.tech/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/adv2.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-497" style="aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;width:170px"/></figure>
<!-- /wp:image -->

<!-- wp:heading {"textAlign":"center","level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Мини-группы</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"align":"center"} -->
<p class="has-text-align-center">Индивидуальное живое общение и возможность задавать вопросы</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></div>
<!-- /wp:column -->

<!-- wp:column -->
<div class="wp-block-column"><!-- wp:image {"id":498,"width":"170px","aspectRatio":"1","scale":"cover","sizeSlug":"full","linkDestination":"none","align":"center","className":"item-decor"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full is-resized item-decor"><img src="http://emoshop.aleks9sw.beget.tech/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/adv3.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-498" style="aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;width:170px"/></figure>
<!-- /wp:image -->

<!-- wp:heading {"textAlign":"center","level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Художник-ведущий</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"align":"center"} -->
<p class="has-text-align-center">Не просто педагог, а ментор вдохновения и творчества</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></div>
<!-- /wp:column --></div>
<!-- /wp:columns -->

<!-- wp:columns -->
<div class="wp-block-columns"><!-- wp:column -->
<div class="wp-block-column"><!-- wp:image {"id":499,"width":"170px","height":"170px","scale":"cover","sizeSlug":"full","linkDestination":"none","align":"center","className":"item-decor"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full is-resized item-decor"><img src="http://emoshop.aleks9sw.beget.tech/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/adv4.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-499" style="object-fit:cover;width:170px;height:170px"/></figure>
<!-- /wp:image -->

<!-- wp:heading {"textAlign":"center","level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Формат «без правил»</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"align":"center"} -->
<p class="has-text-align-center">Не нужно быть профессионалом — творим для удовольствия</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></div>
<!-- /wp:column -->

<!-- wp:column -->
<div class="wp-block-column"><!-- wp:image {"id":500,"width":"170px","aspectRatio":"1","scale":"cover","sizeSlug":"full","linkDestination":"none","align":"center","className":"item-decor"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full is-resized item-decor"><img src="http://emoshop.aleks9sw.beget.tech/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/adv5.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-500" style="aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;width:170px"/></figure>
<!-- /wp:image -->

<!-- wp:heading {"textAlign":"center","level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Дополнительные фишки</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"align":"center"} -->
<p class="has-text-align-center">Лёгкие закуски, вино/напитки, музыкальный фон</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></div>
<!-- /wp:column -->

<!-- wp:column -->
<div class="wp-block-column"><!-- wp:image {"id":501,"width":"170px","aspectRatio":"1","scale":"cover","sizeSlug":"full","linkDestination":"none","align":"center","className":"item-decor"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full is-resized item-decor"><img src="http://emoshop.aleks9sw.beget.tech/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/adv6.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-501" style="aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;width:170px"/></figure>
<!-- /wp:image -->

<!-- wp:heading {"textAlign":"center","level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Гарантия результата</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"align":"center"} -->
<p class="has-text-align-center">Абсолютно каждый участник уходит с готовым творением</p>
